plateTectonics.review: The five new claim strings match the approximate USGS teaching relationships. The 10-times energy option is an intentionally incorrect quiz distractor, with feedback distinguishing amplitude from energy. The tool separately explains local vs moment magnitude and cautions that shaking at a site has no fixed multiplier.

beeFlight.correction: Replaced a single approximate acceleration factor with the full reference-time range and separated countdown compression from the movement game scale. A new localization key prevents stale translations of the earlier statement from overriding the correction.
